content_note: Every rule here is intent-only: a name, an id and a logic line that names the detections the rule would join. There is no query, schedule, severity or alert mapping, so nothing in this file can be imported into a tenant as-is. Author the rule in the XSIAM console from the logic line.

rules.logic: BIOC(DCSync Replication Request from a Non-Domain-Controller Account) AND (BIOC(AnyDesk RAT Registered as a Scheduled Task for Persistence on a Domain Controller) OR ABIOC(DCSync-to-Persistence Behavioral Chain on a Domain Controller)) on the same domain-controller host and stolen service account within 600s -> raise ONE 'Ransomware Precursor' incident at CRITICAL and trigger XSOAR playbook Ransomware-Precursor-AutoContain (isolate the DC, disable the stolen service account, block the exfil egress ASN). The playbook fires at this junction so the T1486 ESXi mass-encryption impact is CONTAINED rather than observed. F5 Response/Automation KPI: the correlation fires AND the playbook completes before impact.
rules.name: Ransomware Precursor Auto-Containment — DCSync + Scheduled-Task-Persistence Junction Fires XSOAR R&R Playbook
